## Context

Ship durable bridge status on all established entry points without removing old vocabulary. Canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden compatibility alias `rebar bridge-status` must use the same parser and core, with identical options, text/JSON output, errors, and exits. Existing preview, sync, pause, resume, reconcile compatibility, library/MCP behavior, workflows, and installation paths remain intact. The production canary moves from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable git state while retaining one-release explicit rollback.

## Durable writer and state

Replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer. Every mutating reconciler pass that survives to finalization writes minimal authoritative JSON to `refs/reconciler/last-pass`: schema version, pass id, selected environment id, outcome, optional failure kind, completion time, and observed lock fence.

Advance the ref through observed-OID CAS with `--force-with-lease=refs/reconciler/last-pass:<observed-oid>`, reusing existing mismatch classification. Allow three total attempts, refetching after mismatch and sleeping 100 ms then 200 ms. Exhausted contention or persistent push/network/permission failure is an operational failure: emit a clear error, return nonzero, and never claim durability.

Write last-pass before releasing `refs/reconciler/lock`; keep heartbeat active during CAS, then stop and release promptly. CAS retries remain visibly RUNNING. The recorded fence is provenance only; RUNNING and CRASHED use the live lock snapshot. If all writes fail, release the lock but preserve the nonzero result and prior stale record.

Rich detail is one rolling `.tickets-tracker/.bridge_state/last-pass.json`, overwritten and committed by the normal tickets-branch path. Status includes detail only when pass and environment ids match the authoritative ref; missing/stale/mismatched detail is diagnosed but cannot change the verdict. Remove duplicate producers and dead baseline fields after semantic plus string/monkeypatch reference sweeps.

## Identity continuity

This rule applies only to last-pass writer/status, not inbound event metadata. Explicit `REBAR_ENV_ID` wins. The reconcile workflow continues supplying `reconciler`. Otherwise writer/status derive stable `local:<repo-env-id>` from checkout `.env-id`. Missing, empty, or unreadable `.env-id` is a hard configuration error, never a fallback to reconciler or unknown. Preserve `LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID=reconciler`, inbound event metadata, reducer inference, and old projections unchanged. The canary explicitly targets `reconciler`.

## Status contract

Status is a fast, read-only, non-mutating single snapshot and never calls `steal()` or sleeps for a lease. It reads last-pass, matching optional detail, pause state, and live lock OID/fence/lease.

Canonical and legacy commands expose identical facts. Total precedence is `PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY`; lower facts remain diagnostic. `NEVER_RUN` applies only without both record and live lock.

- HEALTHY: matching success, exit 0.
- PAUSED: matching intentional pause, exit 0 even when old.
- RUNNING: live lock, exit 0 with OID, fence, lease.
- STALE: matching unpaused record older than explicit `--max-age`, exit 1. Omitting max-age disables age failure.
- FOREIGN: record environment differs from selected target, exit 1 with both ids.
- NEVER_RUN: no record and no live lock, exit 1.
- FAILED: process-surviving failure, exit 1 with failure kind.
- CRASHED: canary-only result after two read-only snapshots across the lock-carried lease show unchanged OID/fence, exit 1.

The lock blob supplies `lease_secs` and defaults to 120. The canary waits the observed lease. Values over 480 seconds fail immediately because of the fixed ten-minute workflow budget; never cap and misclassify. SIGKILL/OOM/runner teardown are witnessed only by stalled live fence, not invented last-pass failure.

## Surfaces, canary, and compatibility

Add canonical parser/help/dispatch and route hidden `bridge-status` through the same bridge parser/core. Keep it absent from top-level help and intercept commands; remove only bridge-status from retired-command assertions and keep purge-bridge retired. Regenerate byte-exact bridge help and CLI reference.

Roll out producer before consumer: retain explicit `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api` until one durable producer write, then default to `status`. Canary fetches `+refs/reconciler/*:refs/reconciler/*`, targets reconciler, performs two snapshots for a live lock, preserves alert tickets/dedup/failure behavior, and makes no heartbeat API query on the canonical path. Keep explicit github-api rollback for one release.

## Architecture and verification

ADR 0094 records the authoritative ref, rolling detail, write-before-release order, stalled-fence witness, rejected timestamp/accumulating-file alternatives, and rollback. It explicitly extends ADR 0031 live-fence, lease-blob, and shared CAS-classifier precedent. Follow the current numbering convention with `docs/adr/.numbers/0094`, generated index, `check_adr_numbers.py`, and `gen_adr_index.py --check`; if origin/main claims 0094, allocate the next free four-digit number and regenerate references.

RED-first held-out coverage proves canonical/legacy parity; all verdicts/exits; no mutation; identity separation; durable success/hard-failure ordering; stalled-fence crash detection; exact CAS retry/backoff/failure; rolling-detail degradation; real-ref canary fetch; status default, rollback, and ticket escalation; legacy bridge/reconcile continuity; removed-symbol sweeps; and ADR/index currency. Run focused status/reconciler/canary/workflow/help/compatibility suites, ADR checkers, lint, typecheck, and CI test gates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Canonical bridge status and hidden bridge-status are identical read-only entrypoints; preview/sync/pause/resume and purge retirement remain compatible.
- [x] Exact verdict, precedence, facts, and exit contracts are implemented.
- [x] Local and CI identities cannot collide; inbound legacy Jira and workflow reconciler identity remain unchanged.
- [x] One producer records success and process-surviving failure before lock release with exact bounded CAS behavior.
- [x] Duplicate producer/baseline symbols are removed after semantic and string reference sweeps.
- [x] Rich detail is one rolling file and safely degrades when absent or mismatched.
- [x] Crash detection uses two read-only live-fence snapshots across the holder lease.
- [x] Canary ref fetch, status default, escalation, no canonical heartbeat query, bootstrap, and rollback are proven.
- [x] ADR numbering marker/index follow the current convention and both checker commands pass.
- [x] [operator-attested] RED-first focused tests and Gerrit/GitHub CI prove contracts and continuity.
      provenance: environment=Gerrit-change-1576/GitHub-Actions-CI-at-fe5a447061cde0367a2262aee91aadefc242e670; principal=rebar-review-bot-and-GitHub-hosted-CI-runners; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call
